scenario: mount point with a space encoded as \040 in mountinfo (/srv/my\040data) must be decoded to /srv/my data so a path under it resolves to that xfs mount (usrquota -> enabled/enforced) instead of the shorter /srv mount (noquota -> disabled).

fixture.mountinfo:
26 33 0:24 / /proc rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:5 - proc proc rw
33 2 0:30 /@ / rw,noatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,compress=zstd:3,ssd,discard=async,space_cache=v2,subvolid=256,subvol=/@
42 33 0:44 / /srv rw,relatime shared:12 - xfs /dev/mapper/srv rw,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=256k,noquota
43 33 0:45 / /srv/my\040data rw,relatime shared:13 - xfs /dev/mapper/data rw,inode64,usrquota,attr2

rationale: Contract table rows: xfs + 'any of usrquota,uquota,quota,grpquota,gquota,prjquota,pquota and no noquota' -> quota_state 'enabled', enforcement 'enforced', basis 'xfs_quota_option'; xfs + 'noquota and no quota key' -> 'disabled', enforcement 'n/a', basis 'xfs_noquota_option' (contract.md C2 quota-classification table, rows 1-2). Verdict precedence: 'else any enabled -> 1 QUOTA_ENABLED (positive evidence is never hidden by an unknown sibling)' (contract.md C2 verdict precedence), so the run exits 1 with finding_id QUOTA_ENABLED even though the second path is disabled. Mount resolution: 'parse mountinfo per proc.rst 3.5 (fields 1-6, optional fields until -, then fstype, source, super options); decode octal escapes (\040, \011, \012, \134) in the mount point' and 'Candidate mounts: mount point equals realpath, or is /, or realpath starts with mount point + /. Choose the longest mount point; among equal mount points the last line wins' (contract.md C2 mount resolution). For realpath '/srv/my data/sub dir' the decoded mount points are '/', '/srv' and '/srv/my data'; the longest that prefixes it is '/srv/my data' (mountinfo line 4, field 5 written '/srv/my\040data', decoded to '/srv/my data'), whose fstype is xfs and super options 'rw,inode64,usrquota,attr2' contain 'usrquota' and no 'noquota'. '/srv' (line 3, super options 'rw,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=256k,noquota') is a shorter candidate and must lose; if the octal escape were not decoded the only prefix candidate would be '/srv' and the path would be misreported as disabled/xfs_noquota_option. For realpath '/srv/plain' the candidates are '/' and '/srv' only ('/srv/my data' is not a prefix of '/srv/plain'), so mount_point '/srv', fstype xfs, super options carry 'noquota' and no quota key -> disabled/n/a/xfs_noquota_option. Device check: 'If chosen fstype is not btrfs and its major:minor != the path's st_dev -> unknown basis device_mismatch ... equal -> device_check match' (contract.md C2); the fixture gives st_dev 0:45 for the first path against mount major:minor 0:45, and 0:44 against 0:44 for the second, so no device_mismatch branch is entered. The '/' btrfs line is present for realism and as a shorter candidate only; it is never the longest match for either path, so its btrfs_sysfs entry cannot influence the verdict. Source anchors: S082 (proc.rst section 3.5, field table 1970-1983: major:minor field 3, separator, filesystem type, mount source, super options) supports the field layout used for the mount-point and super-option extraction; S077 (Documentation/admin-guide/xfs.rst, noquota 171-173, uquota/usrquota/uqnoenforce/quota 175-177) supports 'noquota' as 'Forcibly turns off all quota accounting and enforcement' and 'usrquota' as accounting enabled with limits optionally enforced; S078 (fs/xfs/xfs_super.c xfs_fs_show_options quota emission 238-254: 'usrquota' on XFS_UQUOTA_ENFD, 'uqnoenforce' on XFS_UQUOTA_ACCT, 'noquota' only when no accounting flag is set) supports that 'usrquota' and 'noquota' are the two kernel-emitted super-option keys, and therefore that the two xfs lines are internally consistent kernel output.
